raw_artifact_traceability_audit.findings: While raw markdown evaluation reports (E01, E02, E03, E04) exist in root with figure-ready JSON snippets, the backend evaluation_service.py executes mock simulation functions (_simulate_retriever) rather than querying SQLite/PostgreSQL EvaluationItem DB records directly. Therefore, running benchmark API calls produces simulated results rather than executing live evaluations against ds_nexus_v10 DB records.
